title: Teams and ready-made layouts without the dashboard
items: Teams can be created, renamed and deleted, members removed, invites withdrawn and team billing changes priced from the API, `whk`, the TypeScript SDK and the MCP server
Deleting a team with an API key or agent token waits for the owner's approval, since it ends the team's subscription at once
The ready-made email layouts can be listed with the API and added to an endpoint from `whk`, the SDK and the MCP server, and named email fields can be tried on a captured email from all three
